# dsh-plugins
English | 中文
A collection of DeepSeek Harness plugins, kept in one pnpm workspace.
Every package declares `dsh.bundle` — the manifest field the Harness plugin list accepts. That singl
e field is what makes a package installable with `dsh plugin add`, gives it its own Loader rows at s
tart-up, and qualifies it for the plugin marketplace.
## Plugins
| Package | What it does | Kind |
| `dsh-balance-floater` | Puts the account balance beside the sidebar account button, and pops arcad

e damage numbers whenever it drops | UI |
| `dsh-theme-picker` | Installs any number of theme packs

and switches between them instantly, with no reload and no first-paint flash | Theme |
| `dsh-theme-

dracula-pack` | A Dracula palette pack for the theme picker | Theme |
| `dsh-solar-term` | A solar-t
erm badge at the top-left of the conversation: the current term, its exact moment, and the days unti
l the next one | UI |
## Package names
`dsh-theme-picker` is not called `dsh-theme-manager` because that name is already taken on npm by an
unrelated plugin of the same kind. `dsh-theme-dracula-pack` carries the `-pack` suffix to stay dist
inguishable from the upstream PuerJJJ/dsh-theme-dracula plugin, which is a plugin of its own. Read t
he full name before installing.

### From the marketplace
Add an index source under **Settings → Plugins → Discover → Index sources**, then search for the pac

## Local development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The script does three things, and the third one is easy to miss:
1. links each package into `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/` (a junction on Windows, a direc

tory symlink elsewhere), so edits reach DSH on the next start;
2. appends the package name to that p

rofile's `dsh.profile.bundles`, so its `dsh.bundle.patch.yml` is applied at start-up;
3. records `li
nk:<repo path>` in the profile's `dependencies`, because that is the field the **Plugins → Installed
** list reads. A package registered only as a bundle loads perfectly and never appears there — the f
ull story is in AGENTS.md.
It never runs pnpm and never touches `pnpm-lock.yaml`.
> If you installed these packages earlier by hand-writing `insert` rows in the profile's `cordis.pat
ch.yml`, delete those rows first: one package loaded from two Loader sources is refused by the clien
those rows first: one package loaded from two Loader sources is refused by the client module system.
## Why every package is a bundle
DSH's plugin list only accepts a package whose `package.json` declares **`dsh.bundle`**. A package w
ith `dsh.client` alone can still be loaded by the browser, but it cannot be installed and never show
s up on the plugin page.
So every package here ships a `dsh.bundle.patch.yml` holding the Loader rows it inserts:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The package name in `dsh.profile.bundles` makes that patch apply at start-up, which inserts the row.
Nobody edits YAML by hand.
`dsh-theme-dracula-pack` is pure data: its patch is an empty array (`[]`). It contributes no Loader
rows; the bundle declaration exists so `dsh plugin add` can put it into `node_modules` where the pic
dle declaration exists so `dsh plugin add` can put it into `node_modules` where the picker finds it.

## Release
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`release.yml` packs `dist/<name>-<version>.tgz` plus a stable `dist/<name>.tgz` alias for each packa
ge, attaches both to the GitHub Release, and publishes to npm when the `NPM_TOKEN` secret exists.
Versions live in each package's own `package.json`, so one tag can ship a patch release of a single
package — npm skips versions that already exist.
## Listing in the plugin marketplace
awesome-dsh-plugin is the official index. It indexes *plugins*, and a monorepo subpackage has its ow
n spelling (from its contributing guide):

| `url` | `https://github.com/yinqiang/dsh-plugins/tree/main/packages/dsh-theme-picker` |
| `name` |

`yinqiang/dsh-plugins#dsh-theme-picker` |
| File name | `yinqiang__dsh-plugins--packages-dsh-theme-

h-plugins#dsh-theme-picker` |
| File name | `yinqiang__dsh-plugins--packages-dsh-theme-picker.yml` |
Three gates apply:
1. `package.json` declares **`dsh.bundle`** — checked automatically on the PR, and declaring `dsh.cl

ient` only is the most common reason a submission is rejected;
2. the repository is at least one day

old and carries the `dsh-plugin` topic;
3. the index only lists packages that are **published to np
